evidence_candidates.claim: AI Act Article 26(9) provides that, where applicable, deployers of high-risk AI systems use the information supplied under Article 13 to comply with their GDPR Article 35 or Directive (EU) 2016/680 Article 27 data-protection-impact-assessment obligation.
qualifiers: This wording is combined with the Article 113 application schedule in SRC-0043; it does not itself establish that every high-risk system or every AI deployment requires a DPIA.
evidence_candidates.relevance: AI Act to GDPR information hand-off.

evidence_candidates.claim: For the Article 26(9) obligation within Chapter III Sections 1, 2 and 3, the amended Article 113 schedule applies the relevant rules from 2 December 2027 for Article 6(2)/Annex III high-risk systems and from 2 August 2028 for Article 6(1)/Annex I high-risk systems, subject to the Article 6(5) exception.
qualifiers: The date depends on the system classification route and is not a universal application date.

classification_proposals.basis: Official AI Act text; no direct Article 26(9) replacement identified in the assigned amendment.
Official binding amending act providing the Article 113 schedule.

unresolved_items: GDPR Articles 35, 36 and 39 currentness remains unresolved.
Independent audit must verify that the two candidates are used together and that the route qualifier is retained.
